programme.title: True Crime Story
programme.desc: It Couldn't Happen Here: Iaeger, W. Va.. In this true-crime story, a beloved town doctor perishes in a deadly house fire -- which investigators conclude was arson; but after securing a murder conviction, the prosecutor doubts his own evidence and joins the fight to free an innocent man.

programme.title: True Crime Story
programme.desc: It Couldn't Happen Here: Atwater, Ohio. In this true-crime story, cold-case investigators looking into a double murder elicit a series of confessions from a group of teens; years later, the teens recant their statements; aggressive tactics may have sent an innocent man to death row.

programme.title: True Crime Story
programme.desc: It Couldn't Happen Here: Turlock, California. A criminal defense attorney known for uncovering corruption finds himself on trial; accused of a complex murder-for-hire plot, along with eight others, he fights to clear his name and show the holes in the state's case.

programme.title: True Crime Story
programme.desc: It Couldn't Happen Here: Royse City, Texas. A couple are found brutally murdered in their home; investigators learn that the last person to see them alive had secrets of his own; some question whether prejudice led police to arrest the wrong man.

programme.title: True Crime Story
programme.desc: It Couldn't Happen Here: Edgewater, Florida. A dentist is killed by a masked gunman; the media reports salacious details as investigators uncover a sinister plot led by the dentist's wife and stepson, but a private investigator shares a startling alternate theory.

programme.title: True Crime Story
programme.desc: It Couldn't Happen Here: Adel, Georgia. The town of Adel, Ga., is rocked by a brutal robbery homicide, and locals quickly point to an outsider as the killer; over 20 years later, new evidence raises the startling question if an innocent man is serving life for another man's crime.

programme.title: True Crime Story
programme.desc: It Couldn't Happen Here: Sauquoit, New York. When a beloved chiropractor in Sauquoit, N. Y., dies suddenly under strange circumstances, investigators discover she's been murdered with a rare poison; the killer could only be someone she knew closely, and the case divides the town.

programme.title: True Crime Story
programme.desc: It Couldn't Happen Here: St. Augustine, Florida. A young woman in St. Augustine, Fla., with everything to live for is found shot to death with the gun belonging to her boyfriend, a deputy sheriff; he says it was suicide, but her family believes it was murder.

programme.title: True Crime Story
programme.desc: It Couldn't Happen Here: Cookeville, Tennessee. When an immigrant couple who settled in the Tennessee town of Cookeville is executed in their sleep and their house set on fire, investigators identify a suspect with motive; in their rush to make an arrest, they may have gotten the wrong man.

programme.title: True Crime Story
programme.desc: It Couldn't Happen Here: Shelbyville, Kentucky. In rural Shelbyville, Ky., a body is found in the river; years go by until the police catch the killer, but some in town question if the suspect is even capable of committing the crime.

programme.title: True Crime Story
programme.desc: Rockville / Ellington, Connecticut. When a 22-year-old dancer goes missing, the men of the neighboring town who frequented the club she worked at become the suspect pool; wealth and status may protect a killer; a determined police officer works the case.

programme.title: True Crime Story
programme.desc: It Couldn't Happen Here: Dallas, Ga.. In this true-crime story, after a woman is found shot in her bathroom, officials launch a death investigation to determine if it was suicide -- as her husband claimed -- or murder; years later, the case remains open, and the town still has questions.

programme.title: True Crime Story
programme.desc: It Couldn't Happen Here: Pocomoke City, Md.. In this true-crime story, a young single mother disappears without a trace; an investigation suggests she abandoned her children, while her family spends years proving she was murdered and finding her killers.

programme.desc: It Couldn't Happen Here: Angier, N. C.. In this true crime story, a man claims he shot his daughter's estranged husband, Christian Griggs, in self-defense -- but after investigators close the case, Christian's family discovers evidence that the killing was not justified.

programme.title: Dark Winds
programme.desc: Monster Slayer - S1E1. Navajo Tribal Policeman Joe Leaphorn must solve a series of crimes; he partners with new deputy, Jim Chee, who is back on the reservation for the first time since he was a child; together they face down evil forces, both earthly and supernatural. (06/12/2022)

programme.title: Dark Winds
programme.desc: The Male Rain Approaches - S1E2. Leaphorn and Chee interview the surviving witness to the Big Rock Motel murders; Chee meets with the coroner; the cause of death remains a mystery; Sgt. Manuelito makes a chilling discovery of her own. (06/12/2022)

programme.title: Dark Winds
programme.desc: K'e - S1E3. Leaphorn's niece celebrates her Kinaaldá as Leaphorn retrieves the bodies of the murder victims; Manuelito and Chee investigate the whereabouts of the missing Mormon family. (06/19/2022)

programme.title: Dark Winds
programme.desc: Hooghandi - S1E4. Leaphorn suspects all the crimes on the reservation are related; there is a big break in the case; Leaphorn invites Chee over for dinner; Manuelito makes a discovery of her own. (06/26/2022)

programme.title: Dark Winds
programme.desc: Ha'íínlni. With a major suspect in custody, Leaphorn discovers that there is more to this crime than he would have ever imagined; Manuelito faces her worst fears; Chee must make a choice between his career and his people.

programme.title: Dark Winds
programme.desc: HózhóoNaasháa - S1E6. Leaphorn, Chee and Manuelito descend on the hiding place of the Buffalo Society, only to be confronted with hard decisions that could change the outcome of the rest of their lives. (07/10/2022)

programme.title: Squawk Box
programme.desc: The big names in business and politics tell their important stories in this pre-market morning news and talk program; from professional traders to casual investors.

programme.title: Squawk on the Street
programme.desc: Taking viewers onto the floor of the exchange, right to the posts where the big companies in the world trade; tick charts track the action of every trade of every stock; the treasury, currency and commodity action in real time.

programme.title: Halftime Report
programme.desc: The front lines of market coverage; host Scott Wapner and the top investors get to the heart of the action as it's happening and help set the agenda for the rest of the day.

programme.title: The Exchange
programme.desc: Anchor Kelly Evans reports on the important stories to markets and investors; reporters provide actionable information to viewers as they make daily investment decisions.

programme.title: Power Lunch
programme.desc: Focusing on real-time market coverage, breaking news and up-to-the-instant stock moving information; delving into the economy, the markets, real estate, media and technology.

programme.title: Closing Bell
programme.desc: A guide through the most important hour of the Wall Street trading day, and taking a close-up look at how the markets are moving, what's driving them and how investors are reacting; coverage includes reports from the CME Group, NASDAQ and the NYSE.

programme.title: Closing Bell: Overtime
programme.desc: Melissa Lee and Michael Santoli take viewers through all the after-hours moves including breaking news, corporate earnings and post-market trading; strategists and money managers debate actionable ideas and the market themes of the day.

programme.title: Fast Money
programme.desc: The information normally reserved for the Wall Street trading floor, enabling viewers to make decisions that give them a chance to make money; the news with an angle that won't be seen until tomorrow's papers.

programme.title: Mad Money
programme.desc: Taking viewers inside the mind of one of Wall Street's most respected and successful money managers; Jim Cramer guides viewers through the confusing jungle of Wall Street investing, navigating through both opportunities and pitfalls.

programme.title: The Neighborhood
programme.desc: Welcome to Fight Night - S1E13. Calvin reluctantly invites Dave to join his guys' night at home with Malcolm and Marty; Gemma and Tina take their first girls' trip to Vegas and find themselves unexpectedly in the spotlight. (02/04/2019)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Mermaidman Begins / Plankton's Good Eye. SpongeBob and Patrick learn the secret origins of Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy; Plankton grows a second eye and becomes nice.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Save a Big Brother; Pups Save a Giant Baby. Farmer Yumi dreams about what her new baby will be like when she's bigger.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Big Truck Pups Save the Swiped Speakers; Big Truck Pups Save the Big Big Pipes. When Mayor Humdinger hijacks Al's big rig carrying Luke Stars and his concert equipment, it's up to the pups to rescue him; when Al's load of pipes breaks loose, it's up to the pups to save their friends from the rolling hazards.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Plus a Plucky Chicken; Pups Save a Pet Show. When Humdinger steals Farmer Al's super-powered seeds, Chickaletta joins the PAW Patrol to help stop the mayor's corny plan; when Humdinger steals Katie and Cali's tiaras, it's up to the pups to save their costumes and the pet show.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: All Paws on Deck - S9E27. Ryder and his team of pups must take on 10-year-old genius Codi Gizmodi, who has her sights set on building her own high-tech city to replace Adventure Bay; joining the team are Everest, Tracker, Sweetie, Tuck and Ella, Rex, Liberty and more. (12/17/2022)

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Stop the Falling Space Junk; Pups Stop the Giant Cuckoo. When Digi and Tal's space vacuum breaks, it's up to the pups to save Mayor Humdinger from falling space debris; Humdinger's cuckoo clock goes out of control; Ryder and the Pups must rescue Travis and get control of the cuckoo to save Humdinger.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Pups and the Werepuppy!; Pups Save a Sleepwalking Mayor. When Rocky goes missing at Uncle Otis' cabin in the woods, the PAW Patrol needs to solve the mystery of the Werepuppy; on Cowboy Day at the Wingnuts Dude Ranch, Mayor Goodway braves the hazards of the ranch while sleepwalking.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Save a Dino Digi and Tal; Pups Save a Dino Daredevil. Digi and Tal are visiting Dino Island to help Rex with dinosaur safety; when they take safety too far, they accidentally put the island at risk; when Daring Danny X's dino-stunt goes awry, he winds up with a grouchy Spinosaurus.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Save the Dino Chicken - S13E13. The PAW Patrol team and Mayor Goodway travel to Dino Island for a tour led by Rex; during the visit, the group discovers that Timmy the Tyrannosaurus rex fears Mayor Goodway's pet chicken, Chickaletta. (09/05/2026)

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Save the Kitties and the Kiddies; Pups Save the Greenhouse. Humdinger's hands are full when he babysits his new friend's kids; Everest helps the pups rescue both mayors trapped inside a greenhouse.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Mission PAW: Royally Spooked!; Pups Save Monkey-Dinger. The pups go to Barkingburg to investigate when the Princess thinks she has seen a ghost; while on safari with Carlos and Tracker, Mayor Humdinger steals a magic mask.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew
programme.desc: The Crew Builds a Skyscraper Parts 1 & 2. Rubble and crew are building their biggest construction project ever, a skyscraper; and a job that huge calls for brand-new, mega-sized construction vehicles; but when Speed Meister sees the pups' big trucks, he calls in help from his big brother.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Pups and the Ghost Pirate - S1E19. The PAW Patrol attend a Halloween party on an old pirate ship; the pirate ship begins to head out to sea. (09/13/2013)

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Save the Honey; Pups Save Mayor Goodway's Purse. Yumi's Yummy Honey is all the buzz when it -- and her beehive -- go missing from her farm; Mayor Goodway's purse disappears, along with its precious cargo, Chickaletta.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Pups and the Ghost Pirate - S1E19. The PAW Patrol attend a Halloween party on an old pirate ship; the pirate ship begins to head out to sea. (09/13/2013)

programme.title: Valiente: A Tracker Story
programme.desc: When Tracker and Carlos come across a series of nocturnal animals fleeing the scariest part of the region, the Shadow Jungle, Tracker, with the help from Ryder and the PAW Patrol, must brave his fear of the dark and stop a new villain, Lucita Mala.

programme.title: Dr. Seuss' the Lorax
programme.desc: To find the one thing that will win him the girl of his dreams, a boy delves into the story of a grumpy forest creature who fights to protect his world. (2012)

programme.title: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
programme.desc: Escape From Krinkle's - S3E7. Boss Baby has an interview at Baby Corp, but he has to break out of a high-tech Bubbeezee playroom first; the field team strives to help him escape. (03/16/2020)

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: S10E26. Con Girl; No Fun Run. Ever wonder what it's like to grow up in a big family? Eleven-year-old Lincoln Loud gives viewers an inside look at how to survive the chaos of a huge household, especially as the only boy with ten sisters! (10/23/2026)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: S5E26. Toilet Training / The Patrick Show Reunion. After biting Squidward, Tinkle is sent to obedience training. In the not-so-distant future, the Star family produces a reunion episode. (10/23/2026)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Toilet Training - S5E26. The Squid and the Square; The Over-Under. After capturing the Lawnies' attention, SpongeBob and Squidward become a hit new live act; after Cecil stumbles into a pile of underwear, he becomes an underwear salesman.

programme.title: Minions
programme.desc: On a mission to find a new master to serve, three Minions meet Scarlet Overkill, the world's first female supervillain. (2015)

programme.title: Friends
programme.desc: The One With the Engagement Picture - S7E5. Rachel makes her handsome new assistant hang out with Joey rather than the women in her office. (11/02/2000)

programme.title: Friends
programme.desc: The One With the Nap Partners - S7E6. Monica makes Chandler apologize to an old girlfriend for leaving her because she was fat; Monica struggles to select a maid of honor. (11/09/2000)

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Middle Earth Paradigm - S1E6. Leonard, Sheldon, Wolowitz and Koothrappali attend Penny's Halloween party. (10/29/2007)

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Thespian Catalyst - S4E14. Sheldon takes acting lessons from Penny in hope of becoming a better teacher; Koothrappali fantasizes about his friend's girlfriend. (02/03/2011)

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Benefactor Factor - S4E15. A wealthy donor makes Leonard question what he is willing to do for science. (02/10/2011)

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Cohabitation Formulation - S4E16. Wolowitz considers taking things with Bernadette to the next level; Leonard and Raj's sister rekindle their relationship. (02/17/2011)

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Toast Derivation - S4E17. Sheldon is upset when he realizes Leonard is the center of their group of friends. (02/24/2011)

programme.title: Friends
programme.desc: The One With Ross' Library Book. Ross' doctoral dissertation is stored in a remote corner of the university library frequently used by students having sex; Rachel and Phoebe bond with Joey's date, then try to convince him to continue seeing her.

programme.title: Friends
programme.desc: The One Where Chandler Doesn't Like Dogs - S7E8. Tag joins for Thanksgiving dinner; Joey may have ruined Rachel's chances with Tag when he opens his mouth during dinner; Phoebe reveals that she has been secretly keeping a dog in her room for a few days while its owner is away. (11/23/2000)
